ruflo.release_body:
## Stable internal packages
The internal `@claude-flow/*` packages are off the alpha line. Everything `npx ruflo@3.48.0` installs now resolves to a single stable version:

| Package | Version |
|---|---|
| `@claude-flow/cli-core` | 3.7.0 |
| `@claude-flow/memory`, `neural`, `shared`, `security`, `mcp` (and the other internal leaves) | 3.0.0 |
| `@claude-flow/plugin-agent-federation`, `plugin-iot-cognitum` | 1.0.0 |

`@claude-flow/embeddings` stays on its alpha line for now.

## Also in this release
- **Guarded public federation registration** (first shipped in 3.47.0 from a release branch) is now on `main`, so this release keeps it.
- **SQL-injection hardening** in the `@claude-flow/plugins` ruvector attention SQL builders. Follow-up for `gnn.ts`: #3531.
- **Smaller, cleaner leaf tarballs.** A `files` allowlist on every leaf stops local runtime state (logs, pids, `settings.json`) from being packed. The three affected alpha versions are deprecated.

PR: #3530

multica.commit_message:
MUL-7801 fix(daemon): follow directory junctions when authorizing repo checkout workdirs (#8958)

* fix(daemon): follow directory junctions when authorizing repo checkout workdirs (#8946)

On Windows, a workspaces root moved to another drive and left behind as a
directory junction put a junction in the middle of every task path.
filepath.EvalSymlinks fails with ENOTDIR on such a path under the winsymlink
semantics Go 1.23+ selects, so the repo checkout authorization added in
v0.4.30 refused every checkout as "not owned by the active task", and the
workdir-reuse check silently declined every follow-up.

Add util.ResolveSymlinks, the strict counterpart of
ResolveSymlinksBestEffort: it follows symlinks and junctions and fails on
any missing component. On Unix it is filepath.EvalSymlinks; on Windows a
junction-free path keeps the spelling EvalSymlinks gives it. Use it in the
checkout authorization and both workdir-reuse checks, and log the real
reason for a 403 and include it in the response.

Co-authored-by: multica-agent <github@multica.ai>

* fix(util): walk extended-length paths in ResolveSymlinks, refuse device-namespace ones

evalPath returns a `\\?\` input unwalked and joins the rest of a path
lexically onto a volume-GUID link target. That is the fail-closed answer for
the best-effort resolver, but ResolveSymlinks feeds a containment check that
can compare two device-namespace spellings with each other: with the active
workdir spelled `\\?\C:\task\workdir`, `\\?\C:\task\workdir\escape\sub` read
as inside it although escape is a junction to another directory, and
canonicalSpelling's fallback kept that unwalked string.

The strict path now converts an extended-length path with a Win32 spelling
and walks it component by component, and returns ErrUnresolvablePath for any
input or result that stays in the device namespace.

Co-authored-by: multica-agent <github@multica.ai>

---------

Co-authored-by: multica-agent <github@multica.ai>

orca.release_body:
Thank you so much for using Orca and for your continued support! ❤️

This patch is built from the September 27 daily build plus fixes picked from main. Pull requests that landed on main after that are not in this build.

## The short version

**Codex:** Codex workers start again on current Codex (0.158). Orca had been waiting for a welcome-screen label that Codex 0.158 removed, so every Codex worker timed out; Orca now recognizes Codex's empty input box instead. Starting a Codex worker with a model or reasoning effort no longer hangs either.

**Codex tabs run on their own:** On Codex 0.157 and newer, every Codex tab in Orca shared one background server started by the first tab, so status and results were credited to the wrong tab and closing the first tab dropped all the others. Each Codex tab in an Orca terminal now runs its own server, so closing one no longer drops the others. New terminals opened after updating get this; terminals already open keep the old behavior until reopened. To keep the shared server, add `export ORCA_CODEX_ISOLATE=0` to your shell startup file. The trade-off of the default: Codex "Run in background", `codex agents`, and opening a session from the Codex desktop app or an IDE won't see sessions started in Orca, and many open tabs use more memory.

**Status bar & workspace UI:** The status bar fits small screens: extra agents fold into a "+N" badge before status labels shrink to icons. Compact agent rows show unread emphasis, and activity threads from floating terminal agents open the right pane.

**Remote & SSH:** SSH hosts that ask for a verification code or other multi-factor prompt are supported, remote file access follows repository ownership, and interrupted remote installs recover without deleting files still in use.

**Editor & browser:** Solidity, Typst, and Twig files are highlighted, Markdown source survives rich-text edits, and browser tools fold into a menu on narrow screens.

**Reliability:** Orchestration workers whose terminal can no longer be found are stopped properly instead of piling up, and many background tasks clean up after themselves when a window reloads or a request is cancelled.

---

## Product experience

### Codex & orchestration

*Codex workers start again on Codex 0.158, each Codex tab in an Orca terminal runs on its own, and stopping a worker reliably ends its process.*

* fix(terminal): run Codex in Orca terminals without the shared background server by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23900
* fix(daemon): roll Codex no-daemon shell launch into a fresh v37 daemon by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23907
* fix(runtime): settle a quiet Codex composer as ready on every version by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23765
* fix(runtime): read Codex readiness from the live screen by @Jinwoo-H in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23475
* fix: await queued Codex trust preflight completion by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23148
* fix(orchestration): reland process-incarnation reap for stale worker terminal handles by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23583
* fix(orchestration): deliver dispatch mail and replies to the current lead by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23325

### Other agents & native chat

*OpenCode, Hermes, Kimi, Grok, and Claude integrations handle edge cases more safely, and long questions in native chat can be expanded.*

* fix: dispose OpenCode 2 hooks after prompt setup and cleanup failures by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23209
* Respect disabled OpenCode variants and refresh WSL settings safely by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23328
* Preserve Hermes YAML configuration during hook installation by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23324
* fix(kimi): don't crash if config.toml is deleted mid-write by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23293
* fix(grok): show zero usage for an explicit zero quota by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23321
* fix(native-chat): let the "Asked" row unfold a long question by @brennanb2025 in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22941
* fix(claude): release permission prompt abort listeners by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23195
* perf(native-chat): release obsolete transcript viewers after reloads by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22982

### Status bar, sidebar & activity

*The status bar fits small screens, compact agent rows show unread state, and activity threads open floating terminal agents.*

* fix(status-bar): fold agents into +N before status labels go icon-only by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23689
* fix(sidebar): show unread emphasis in compact agent rows by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23327
* fix(sidebar): preserve list focus when selecting workspaces by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23320
* feat(activity): reveal threads in floating terminal workspace by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23239

### Terminal

*Git Bash is detected by its install layout, Japanese file links stay intact, and Windows terminals are more robust.*

* fix(terminal): recognize a Git Bash launcher by its install layout by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23308
* fix(terminal): retain Japanese middle dots and tildes in file links by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23322
* fix(windows): preserve relocated terminals and native process scans by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22872
* fix(windows): synchronize native terminal table lifetime by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23257
* perf: cap shared-path scans and synchronize Windows PTY access by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23194
* perf: preserve terminal previews across unrelated settings updates by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23099

### Editor, search & files

*Solidity, Typst, and Twig get syntax highlighting, Markdown source survives rich edits, and grouped search filters keep their commas.*

* fix(editor): highlight Solidity files by @anajuliabit in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/20928
* feat(editor): highlight Typst files and diffs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23323
* fix(editor): highlight Twig templates in files and diffs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23366
* fix(editor): recognize all bundled Monaco language associations by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23371
* fix(editor): preserve Markdown source across rich edits by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23280
* fix(search): keep commas inside grouped file filters by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23319
* fix: remove PDF export temp files after setup failures by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23130
* perf: avoid rescanning partial notebook output frames by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23138

### Browser

*Browser tools fold into a menu on narrow screens, and addresses with explicit ports open correctly.*

* Implement responsive toolbar overflow with tool folding by @AmethystLiang in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23265
* fix(browser): open domains with explicit ports by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23318

### Remote, SSH & WSL

*SSH supports multi-factor (keyboard-interactive) sign-in, remote file access respects repository ownership, and remote installs recover cleanly.*

* feat(ssh): support keyboard-interactive authentication (MFA) by @Chihen-Tai in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/15588
* Keep SSH terminals parked after their own workspace updates by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23193
* fix: exclude canonical SSH roots from local file access by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23196
* fix: honor canonical SSH ownership in worktree listings by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23198
* fix: bind filesystem root grants to their repository owner by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23206
* fix(ssh): preserve interrupted installation outcomes through retries by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23273
* fix(ssh): recover abandoned caches without deleting live dependencies by @OrcaWin in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23281
* fix(ssh): name the missing unzip when Bun archive extraction cannot start by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23298
* Avoid store updates for unchanged SSH repository catalogs by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23034
* fix(worktrees): clear orphan cleanup on BusyBox WSL distros by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23296
* fix(projects): enrich git remote identity for runtime-addressed repo rows by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23300
* fix(persistence): report a discarded cross-host repo update instead of failing silently by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23379

### Source control & code review

*Pull request and review lookups keep the newest result, and Gitea lookups refresh correctly.*

* fix: refresh strict Gitea lookups and synchronize Windows PTY access by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23162
* perf(github): coalesce stronger refreshes after pending requests by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22970
* fix: preserve newer pull request lookup ownership by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23119
* fix: preserve newer hosted review lookup ownership by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23126
* fix: observe linked-issue failures during review generation by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23166
* fix: retire stale review lookups after cache invalidation by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/23182

### Reliability & performance

*Orca releases abandoned work, listeners, and streams after reloads or cancellations, and skips redundant scans and updates.*

* perf(emulator): stop obsolete video streams after renderer reloads by @nwparker in https://github.com/stablyai/orca/pull/22967

orca.commit_message:
test: stop restating internal tuning constants, keep the ones that are contracts (#23950)

Removes ~74 assertions of the form `expect(SOME_CONSTANT).toBe(<literal>)` where
the literal is an internal tuning value — a timeout, retry count, debounce
interval, cache TTL, circuit-breaker window, Tailwind class string. Those cannot
fail for any reason a user would notice: they fail only when someone deliberately
changes the number, and then the test is simply updated. They are copies of the
declaration.

The same pattern is NOT junk when the exact value is observable outside this
process, so those were deliberately kept:
- terminal byte contracts: `\r`, `\x03` ETX, Kitty escapes, `\x1b[?1;2c`;
- wire and capability values: `agent.launch.v2`, protocol 3 / min-compatible 2,
  daemon per-feature boundary versions (a daemon survives app updates, so those
  pin what an old field daemon may be trusted with), relay header tokens;
- security invariants: the `127.0.0.1` bind default, an empty iframe `sandbox`;
- values external processes read: exit code 78 (EX_CONFIG) and exit code 3
  (systemd `RestartPreventExitStatus`), `ORCA_AGENT_SESSION_SPAWN_TOKEN`,
  `npx skills …` commands users paste, on-disk journal schema versions,
  the `orca_<hash>` filename prefix the fish sweeper matches;
- third-party names: expo-router's `unstable_settings` / `ErrorBoundary`,
  iOS Safari's 16px zoom threshold.

Where a case asserted a relation rather than a literal — `A < B`, a sum of parts,
a cap compared against a sibling budget — the relation stays and only the literal
went.

Test-only changes: no production file is touched and no test file is deleted.

GenericAgent Desktop 桌面版 / Desktop

三个平台产物来自同一提交，并在公开发布前统一验证。All three platform artifacts come from one commit and are validated before publication.

## 安装方法 / Installation
- Windows x64：下载 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Windows-Portable.zip`，解压后双击 `GenericAgent.exe`。卸载时运行 `uninstall.bat`，再删除解压目录。
  Windows x64: extract `GenericAgent-Desktop-Windows-Portable.zip`, then launch `GenericAgent.exe`. Run `uninstall.bat` before deleting the extracted directory.
- Linux x86_64：下载并解压 `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`，执行 `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage` 后运行它。卸载时运行 `uninstall.sh`，再删除解压目录。
  Linux x86_64: extract `GenericAgent-Desktop-Linux-Portable.tar.gz`, run `chmod +x GenericAgent.AppImage`, then launch it. Run `uninstall.sh` before deleting the extracted directory.
- macOS Apple silicon (arm64)：打开 `GenericAgent-Desktop-macOS-aarch64.dmg`，把 `GenericAgent.app` 拖入 Applications。
  macOS Apple silicon (arm64): open `GenericAgent-Desktop-macOS-aarch64.dmg` and drag `GenericAgent.app` to Applications.

## 签名状态 / Signing status
Windows 便携版尚未使用代码签名证书，SmartScreen 可能显示警告；运行前请核对 `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt`。
The Windows portable build is not code-signed, so SmartScreen may warn; verify `SHA256SUMS-windows.txt` before running it.

macOS 应用仅使用 ad-hoc 签名，未使用 Apple Developer ID，也未 notarize。首次打开可能需要右键选择“打开”或在“隐私与安全性”中允许。
The macOS app is ad-hoc signed only. It is neither Developer ID signed nor notarized; first launch may require Open from the context menu or approval in Privacy & Security.

SHA-256 清单与各产物一同发布。SHA-256 manifests are included with the artifacts.

claude_codex_bridge.release_body:
# v8.7.4

Released: 2026-09-29

## English

### Conversation continuity

- Claude now attempts its Agent-owned local history after account, API key, or gateway changes instead of treating an authentication fingerprint change as a reason to start empty. Explicit fresh sessions and user-selected session controls still take precedence.
- Codex preserves a validated current native session across credential and route changes. It rebinds the authority generation and resumes the same conversation instead of unnecessarily demoting the binding to a fork or linked fresh session.
- Preserve conversation identity and generation metadata when session records are rewritten. Fresh startup does not accidentally inherit the previous native binding. Claude's recognized missing-conversation fallback retains historical evidence and a reason; authentication, network, and rate-limit failures do not trigger context clearing.
- Pi records manual session switches and completed turns so reopening selects the current observed conversation, not an older persisted binding. Explicit restore disablement remains effective during automatic restart.
- OMP accepts its newer typed title slot before the native session header, avoiding false restore rejection while preserving identity, work-directory, and managed-path checks.
- Refresh the public WeChat group QR image.

### Verification and upgrade

- 402 combined regression and native checks passed. Real Codex 0.157.1, Pi 0.87.1, and OMP 18.3.5 each preserved native identity across three process launches with changed loopback gateways and synthetic keys; the new endpoint received prior user and assistant history. Claude Code 2.1.283 also passed native history replay in the preceding qualification.
- Update CCB, then stop and reopen affected projects when their current work can safely be interrupted. Keep `.ccb` and Provider transcript files; no manual history migration is required. Existing working panes are not hot-upgraded.
- Android metadata follows the existing coordinated release pipeline. This release adds no mobile UI feature; platform support status is unchanged.

### Known limitations

- Native print/JSON and RPC tests do not establish a new interactive-pane or ask/FIFO end-to-end guarantee. Commercial OAuth accounts, remote-only conversations, and arbitrary gateways' tool/reasoning-history compatibility are not covered by loopback tests.
- Missing, corrupted, foreign, or already-lost current bindings are not blindly restored from historical records. Unsaved drafts and in-flight model operations are not recovered. Gemini authority-change handling remains unchanged.

## 中文

### 对话连续性

- Claude 在账号、API key 或中转地址变化后，优先尝试恢复当前 Agent 自有的本地历史，不再因认证指纹变化直接开启空对话。用户明确选择全新对话或指定会话时，仍以用户选择为准。
- Codex 在凭据、路由变化后保留已验证的当前原生会话，更新认证代次后继续同一对话，避免不必要地降级为 fork 或仅关联旧历史的空会话。
- 重写会话记录时保留对话身份和代次信息；全新启动不会误继承旧原生绑定。Claude 确认原生会话不存在后的降级会保留历史证据及原因；认证、网络和限流失败不会触发上下文清空。
- Pi 记录手动会话切换及已完成回合，重新打开时选择当前观测到的对话，而非过时绑定；明确禁用恢复的设置在自动重启时仍有效。
- OMP 支持新版原生会话头前的特定标题记录，避免有效历史被误判，同时保留身份、工作目录和受管路径检查。
- 更新公开微信群二维码。

### 验证与升级

- 402 项组合回归及原生检查通过。真实 Codex 0.157.1、Pi 0.87.1、OMP 18.3.5 均完成三次进程启动，在切换本地模拟中转和测试 key 后保持原生会话身份，新接口收到既有用户消息与助手回复。此前真实 Claude Code 2.1.283 也通过了原生历史回放验证。
- 更新 CCB 后，在当前工作可安全中断时停止并重新打开受影响项目。保留 `.ccb` 和 Provider 历史文件，无需手动迁移；已有工作 pane 不会被热更新。
- Android 元数据沿用现有同步发布流程。本版没有新增手机界面功能，各平台支持状态保持不变。

### 已知限制

- 原生 print/JSON 和 RPC 测试不代表新增了交互 pane 或 ask/FIFO 端到端保证。本地模拟测试未覆盖商业 OAuth 账号、仅保存在远端的会话，以及任意中转对工具/推理历史的兼容性。
- 缺失、损坏、越界或已丢失的当前绑定不会盲目从旧记录恢复；未提交草稿和进行中的模型操作不在恢复范围内。Gemini 的账号变化处理保持不变。

# v0.6.17

> 2026-09-12

Devin CLI 会话记忆、按需读取 SQLite 页，以及任务/会话绑定修复。

## 功能增强

### Devin CLI 会话适配器

`trellis mem` 通过现有的零依赖解析器读取 Cognition Devin CLI 会话，数据在 `~/.local/share/devin/cli/sessions.db`（WAL SQLite）。这不是 `trellis init --devin`（Desktop/Cascade），也不是 Factory Droid。（#614）

* `list` / `search` / `extract` / `context` / `projects` 支持 `--platform devin`
* OpenCode、ZCode 与 Devin 共用 `packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-adapter.ts` 和 `packages/core/src/mem/platforms.ts`
* Devin 会话树要求 `main_chain_id`；缺少 tip 时返回 `devin-main-chain-missing`（不再回退到 `max(node_id)`）
* 解析前去掉 `CREATE TABLE` 的 `--` 行注释，这样 live `sessions.db` 里的 `parent_node_id` 和 `chat_message` 能被识别

## 问题修复

### SQLite 主文件页懒读

`packages/core/src/mem/internal/sqlite-readonly.ts` 里的零依赖 SQLite 读取器按需加载主文件页，不再把整个数据库读进内存。（#596）

### Pi 无头子代理提示

Pi `trellis_subagent` 把 ask-policy 提示转发到父会话。serving heartbeat 设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_PARENT_SESSION`（不用过期的 `PI_SESSION_ID`），设置 `PI_SUBAGENT_CHILD=1`，并丢掉继承来的 `PI_SESSION_ID`，让子进程自己签发会话 id。（#611）

### 活动任务会话回退

当前会话 id 缺失时，不再回退到项目里仅有的那条会话去解析活动任务。该回退改为显式 opt-in，避免一个会话绑到另一个会话的任务。（#608）

### archive 子任务 unlink 回滚

如果 `task.py archive` 在已经 unlink 部分子任务之后失败，会按清除前的快照把每个子任务的 `parent` 写回去。`children` 里的重复条目只快照一次，避免第二次访问把 `parent: null` 写回去。（#613）

## 升级

```bash theme={null}
npm install -g @mindfoldhq/trellis@latest
trellis update
```

无需 `--migrate`。
